d: Long, straight platinum white hair with bangs and a few stray strands framing a youthful face with sharp, narrow light blue eyes. A slender build wearing a white bikini top with a purple neckline, a black open jacket draped over the shoulders, black stockings with garter straps, and black high-heeled shoes. The look is completed by a black headband with two long, upright rabbit ears decorated with purple hearts, while the character holds a large, complex black and grey mechanical firearm.
